name: Daily movie & TV news update agent

mentions.name: Daily movie & TV news update agent
mentions.description: A subscription-based agent that helps users keep up with movie and TV news by sending updates every morning and storing user preferences so it can learn what each person likes.
mentions.problem: It's hard to keep up with movie and TV news, such as tracking when a film like the new Backrooms movie is coming out.
mentions.source_excerpt: So, I built an agent to help remind me -- it's a subscription based service that sends you updates every morning, and stores your preferences so it can learn what you like.

evidence.value: So, I built an agent to help remind me -- it's a subscription based service that sends you updates every morning, and stores your preferences so it can learn what you like.
